# infisical_app_connection_spacelift (Resource)

Create and manage Spacelift App Connection

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_app_connection_spacelift" "example" {
  name        = "spacelift-connection"
  description = "I am a test app connection"
  method      = "api-key-secret"

  credentials = {
    api_url        = "https://<your-account>.app.spacelift.io"
    api_key_id     = "<your-spacelift-api-key-id>"
    api_key_secret = "<your-spacelift-api-key-secret>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Attributes) The credentials for the Spacelift App Connection (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `method` (String) The method used to authenticate with Spacelift. Possible values are: api-key-secret
- `name` (String) The name of the Spacelift App Connection to create. Must be slug-friendly

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description for the Spacelift App Connection.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to scope the app connection to. If not provided, the app connection will be scoped to the organization.

### Read-Only

- `credentials_hash` (String) The hash of the Spacelift App Connection credentials
- `id` (String) The ID of the app connection

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `api_key_id` (String) The API Key ID used to authenticate with Spacelift.
- `api_key_secret` (String, Sensitive) The API Key Secret used to authenticate with Spacelift.
- `api_url` (String) The Spacelift API URL to connect with (e.g., 'https://mycorp.app.spacelift.io').
